meta_data.base_class: Develop a comprehensive <medical surgery> rehabilitation plan - a postoperative recovery and functional reconstruction plan that can be designed based on patient age, weight, type of surgery, and rehabilitation goals.

tool_template.name: Comprehensive_<class>_RecoveryPlan
tool_template.description: Generate a comprehensive <class> recovery plan considering surgery type and recovery goals.

surgery_type.description: The specific type of <class> surgery. It should be a string with a length between 5 and 100 characters.

recovery_goals.description: Specific recovery goals for <class>. It should be a string with a length between 10 and 200 characters.

age.description: The age of the patient. Must be a positive integer, with a minimum value of 1.

weight.description: The weight of the patient in kilograms. Must be a positive number, with a minimum value of 1.

comorbid_conditions.description: Other existing medical conditions (e.g., diabetes, hypertension) that may impact <class> recovery.

has_primary_caregiver.description: Whether the patient has a primary caregiver during recovery.

mobility_assistance_required.description: Whether the patient currently needs assistance to move around.

preferred_recovery_duration_weeks.description: Target number of weeks the patient hopes to fully recover in.

home_environment.description: Brief description of the patient's home setting that may impact recovery (e.g., stairs, no elevator, rural).
